# Learned baseline on real Bookinfo (independent check; generated by topo/check_baseline_bookinfo.py)

Learned from 460 normal snapshots (not the holdout). Test: 284 snapshots = 147 steady fault snapshots (8 episodes) + 137 holdout normals. Envelope q0.99, floor 10.0 ms.
The baseline design was iterated on Online Boutique, not on this data.
REPORT_V3's noisy windows are INCLUDED (the holdout contains window B1, labelled normal but elevated).

| scorer | AP | RC@1 | FPR@0.85 |

| baseline | 0.842 | 0.959 | 0.394 |
| baseline_clamp | 0.661 | 0.959 | 0.394 |
| rule | 0.670 | 0.901 | 0.438 |
| p95 | 0.726 | 0.881 | n/a |
